SELECT MAX(ta.date) AS most_recent_date
FROM Team_Attributes ta
WHERE ta.team_api_id IN (
    SELECT m.home_team_api_id FROM "Match" m WHERE m.league_id = (SELECT id FROM League WHERE name = 'England Premier League')
    UNION
    SELECT m.away_team_api_id FROM "Match" m WHERE m.league_id = (SELECT id FROM League WHERE name = 'England Premier League')
);

SELECT MAX(ta.date) FROM Team_Attributes ta INNER JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id INNER JOIN Match m ON t.team_api_id IN (m.home_team_api_id, m.away_team_api_id) INNER JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id WHERE l.name = 'England Premier League'

SELECT MAX(ta.date) AS most_recent_date
FROM Team_Attributes ta
WHERE ta.team_api_id IN (
    SELECT home_team_api_id FROM Match m WHERE m.league_id = (SELECT id FROM League WHERE name = 'England Premier League')
    UNION
    SELECT away_team_api_id FROM Match m WHERE m.league_id = (SELECT id FROM League WHERE name = 'England Premier League')
);

WITH team_dates AS (
    SELECT m.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id, m.date
    FROM "Match" m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    WHERE l.name = 'England Premier League'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT m.away_team_api_id AS team_api_id, m.date
    FROM "Match" m
    JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
    WHERE l.name = 'England Premier League'
)
SELECT t.team_long_name,
       MAX(td.date) AS most_recent_date
FROM team_dates td
JOIN Team t ON t.team_api_id = td.team_api_id
GROUP BY t.team_long_name;
